displayName: Function apps should enable outbound application traffic routing to Azure Virtual Network
description: By default, regional VNET integration routes only RFC1918 traffic. Set 'vnetRouteAllEnabled' (API < 2024-11-01) or 'outboundVnetRouting.applicationTraffic' (API >= 2024-11-01) to route application traffic via the virtual network. Alternatively, set 'outboundVnetRouting.allTraffic' to route all traffic. Configuration traffic is handled separately by the configuration routing policy. Not for Flex/Consumption plans.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
